items.title: Jimmy Heath interviewed by Monk Rowe, New York City, New York, September 8, 2014
items.q: And even Mingus, I heard he said the same thing

ctx.x: I played the record once and I was done with it. And even Mingus, I heard he said the same thing, it sounded like everybody in the practice room warming up to go on the stage. There’s no distinctive melody there. And what is music? Now we’ve got music that is words and a rhythm and no melody and no harmony. And that is not music to me. It’s music by the kids. They think it’s music. Every generation has their time. My brother went to his death, Percy, told me, “Aww that ain’t gonna last.” I say, “Yes it is Percy.”…
